method: SHA256 over sorted Git-tracked path, mode, content length and raw content for every tracked blob outside docs/ and app/src/androidTest/. This is a conservative superset of consumer source/build inputs.
limits: Not the same complete Git revision, test harness, generated version/configuration or debug/release binary. Actual signed88 artifact identity and its83-to88 update observations remain separately recorded. Full gates must be named by their actual execution source; no failed or unrelated run is relabelled.
